name: Hexworth C2 Device Firmware (XIAO ESP32-C3)
description: Hexworth's reference C2-backed device, compiled for the Seeed XIAO ESP32-C3 (RISC-V single-core, 4MB flash). Same WiFi captive-portal provisioning, optional pairing-code registration, and ping/echo/blink/reboot capabilities as the DevKit V1 build. Uses native USB-CDC over USB-C — no separate USB-Serial bridge. BOOT button on GPIO 9 (factory-reset gesture). No on-board user LED — blink capability flashes a digital pin but is not visible externally.
